fire:
The committee reviewed the budget for the coming year and agreed that the cost of
repairs to the old school should be paid from the reserve fund.

A careful summary of the main findings in the field and an account of
what remains unknown can be found in the second part of the book.

Local farmers have long depended on the river for water, but the supply of
clean water has fallen in the last ten years.

The owner of the building must keep a record on-site that shows the
date, the name and the address of each tenant.

Goals:
a) To identify the common, widely known words used on
an English learner's first reading list.

Students who finish the course early are encouraged to help others, and
teachers should reward them for doing so.

The treaty was not a guarantee of peace or a source of lasting trust, and
trade between the two states soon declined.

The name comes from a Latin word for "salt." The word
refers to the custom of paying soldiers in salt.
